messages:
Rina: dropping the mini-map idea for the version timeline. goal: keep a dense history scannable and make restore actions discoverable but safe. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/minimap/rollouts (page: minimap-ux) Rina: main questions: 1) how prominent should the restore affordance be inside the minimap, 2) keyboard interactions for scrub + restore, 3) copy for small inline confirmations. Oleg: love the mini-map. for prominence: show a tiny restore icon on hover/focus only. default state should be low-visual-weight to avoid accidental clicks. Tanvi: accessibility: hover-only is bad. it must be reachable via keyboard (tab to item, show the icon), and screen readers need a clear label: "Restore version vX (press Enter to open)". Also add aria-describedby pointing to the status text. Hugo: perf note: minimap will render aggregated bins for older history. virtualization for recent 200 items + aggregated buckets beyond that. avoid mounting full DOM. Rina: good. copy candidates for the inline mini-confirm that appears after clicking icon: "Restore v2.8?" small body: "Route 100% new traffic to v2.8. Ongoing requests complete." CTA: "Restore" secondary "Cancel". small enough to sit above the map. thoughts? Oleg: short CTA is good. add an undo affordance: after restore, show toast "Restored v2.8 — Undo" for 25s. that helps folks who clicked too quick. Tanvi: modal vs inline confirm rule: inline confirm for single-region restores under 20% traffic. modal for multi-region or >=20% traffic or if rollback touches infra flags. Modal must trap focus and include aria-live status updates. Hugo: technical: when restore is initiated, frontend should show intermediate state "Restoring..." and prevent duplicate clicks. prefer disabling restore icon and showing spinner inside it. also emit an event for the timeline to animate target version as "incoming". A11yBot: automated check: contrast fail on the small white-on-teal mini-restore icon at 12px. recommendation: use darker teal (#004d45) or add 1px stroke. add sr-only text: "Restore version vX". Rina: noted. Tanvi, can you paste the recommended ARIA snippet for the inline confirm and the modal? Tanvi: sure. inline confirm example (keeps DOM shallow): ```
Version v2.8 deployed 4 days ago. Traffic 0%.
``` Tanvi: modal snippet: ```

Restore version v2.8?

This will route 100% of new traffic to v2.8. Ongoing requests will finish on the current version.

Ready
``` Rina: perfect. also keyboard map proposal for minimap: Tab to focus map, Left/Right to move bins, Enter to open details for focused bin, Space to toggle inline confirm, and Ctrl+Enter to confirm restore (guard). Home/End jump to extremes. document these in the spec. Oleg: small UI nit: show micro-sparkline inside the hovered bin for recent 30 days, otherwise a tiny dot for older bins. keeps visual density down. Tanvi: a11y nit: when a bin is focused, announce via aria-live: "Focused version vX, traffic 12%, status canary". and when restore starts announce "Restore started: routing X% to vX". must not be too noisy. use polite. Hugo: implementation caveat: when using virtualization, ensure the focused element remains mounted while keyboard is interacting. we'll need a focused-element-keeps-mounted wrapper. spike RED-3580. DeployBot: Created RED-3580: "Mini-map: virtualization focus preservation, inline confirm rules, modal ARIA, toast undo" https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RED-3580 :white_check_mark: Rina: action items: 1) update figma with hover/focus states, darker restore icon, undo toast flow, and micro-sparkline rules. 2) add keyboard map + ARIA snippets to interaction spec. 3) call out inline vs modal rule in docs. 4) coordinate with eng for focus-preserve spike (Hugo/Oleg). Oleg: i'll pick up the spike and include a small demo harness to test on older macbooks. Tanvi: i'll draft the a11y checklist and paste SR text examples in PR. Hugo: will schedule perf run and report back. Rina: thanks team 60a i'll push the figma updates tonight and tag folks. closing thread for now. :sparkles:
